note: Orc, Troll, Tauren, and Horde Skyborne keep Alchemy and Engineering for Enhancement, Elemental, and Restoration. One tip per race and role. Do not add an herb circuit or a mining circuit. Do not change the pair. Mining and Blacksmithing stay rejected. Herbalism stays off the pair. Do not bring back Call of Water, Call of Air, or the weapon quests. Do not edit route JSON from this file.

ops.whyShort: Do not add an herb circuit or a mining circuit to feed Alchemy and Engineering. Buy herbs, ore, and parts, or skip the craft.
